map.分析销售/营销漏斗各环节转化，定位流失瓶颈: Analyze conversion at each stage of a sales or marketing funnel to locate the bottleneck
map.📖 查看「销售漏斗计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Sales Funnel Calculator User Guide"
map.销售漏斗：各阶段转化率 = 下一阶段人数 ÷ 上一阶段人数 × 100%；整体转: Sales funnel: conversion at each stage = next stage headcount / previous stage headcount × 100%; overall conversion = customers won / visitors; use this to find the stage losing the most.
map.把访客→线索→商机→客户各级人数填入算整体转化。: Fill in headcount from visitor to lead to opportunity to customer and compute overall conversion.
map.找转化塌方最狠的一级优先补。: Fix the stage with the worst conversion collapse first.
map.对比两个销售团队的漏斗效率。: Compare funnel efficiency between two sales teams.
map.访客 10000 → 线索 2000 → 商机 500 → 客户 200，整体: Visitors 10000 -> leads 2000 -> opportunities 500 -> customers 200, so overall
map.=200/10000=2%；各级 20%/25%/40%，商机→客户 40% 偏: = 200/10000 = 2%; the stage rates are 20% / 25% / 40%, and opportunity to customer at 40% is weak, so coach the sales pitch.
map.团队 A 访客 10000 转化 200（2%），团队 B 同样访客转化 320: Team A converts 200 of 10000 visitors (2%) while team B converts 320 of the same traffic (3.2%); B's funnel is tighter, so replicate its SOP.
map.整体转化低先改哪级？: Which stage to fix when overall conversion is low?
map.改「转化率低且流量大」的级，杠杆最大；别死磕顶部大流量低转化环节。: Fix the stage with low conversion and high traffic, since the leverage is greatest; do not obsess over a top stage with huge traffic and low conversion.
map.各级乘对应客单价可估金额漏斗，定位丢钱最多的环节更直观。: Multiply each stage by its average order value to estimate a revenue funnel, which shows more directly where the most money is lost.
map.销售漏斗计算器。营销分析工具，帮助量化评估营销效果与 ROI。: Sales funnel calculator. A marketing analytics tool for quantifying campaign performance and ROI.
